items.title: Mastercard (MA) Expands Virtual Card Platform As Citi Prepares Global Launch
items.summary: Mastercard announced major upgrades to its virtual card number platform, adding new security controls, an embedded payments network, and unified API access. The company is targeting both enterprises and financial institutions looking to scale and secure virtual card programs. Citi will be the first issuer to launch these capabilities globally, signaling broad industry interest in the expanded platform. items.title: Citigroup (C) Sets Post GFC Record With $817 Million Multifamily CMBS Deal
items.summary: Citigroup priced an $817 million multifamily only CMBS conduit, the largest of its kind for the bank since the global financial crisis. The deal is backed exclusively by multifamily loans and points to active institutional appetite for higher leverage apartment debt. This transaction highlights Citi's role as a key lender in US commercial real estate securitization. items.title: Why agilon health (AGL) Shares Are Falling Today
items.summary: Shares of healthcare services company Agilon Health (NYSE:AGL) fell 10.8% in the afternoon session after Citi downgraded the stock's rating from Neutral to Sell, citing valuation concerns. The downgrade followed a massive 650% rally in 2026, which left the stock trading at a 38% premium compared to its peers.
